body:
{panel:bgColor=#e3fcef}
*OVERALL QA STATUS: PASSED*
{panel}

Tested today on the QA branch [https://sv7208.qa.shopview.com] (build {{v26.39.1-830ae4c}}), with production {{app.shopview.com}} (build {{v26.39.1-3ef6ade}}) used to capture the before-state. All 8 checks passed.

In plain terms: on the build our customers are running today, a shop whose Shop ID is more than two characters long cannot read its own work order number — everything past the eighth character is replaced with two dots. On this branch the whole number is shown, on desktop and on mobile, for both work orders and part sales.

h3. Before and after

!01-work-order-before-after.png|width=900,height=589!

_The same place on the same screen. On production the work order whose real number is {{S2500-931}} shows as {{S2500-93..}}; on the fix branch {{S7208-17580}} is shown in full. Both work orders were brand new, which is why the New Line dialog dims the page behind them in each half._

h3. What I checked

||#||Check||Result||
|1|The reported fault still happens on production|*PASSED* — real number {{S2500-931}}, header shows {{S2500-93..}}|
|2|A new work order in a location with a multi-character Shop ID shows the whole number|*PASSED* — {{S7208-17580}}, Shop ID {{7208}}|
|3|The whole number holds at 1024, 1280, 1440, 1680 and 1920 pixels wide|*PASSED* — nothing cut off at any of the five widths|
|4|The longest Shop ID the app allows (5 characters)|*PASSED* — {{SWXYZ9-17581}}, twelve characters, shown in full|
|5|The status pill moves below the number when there is no room beside it|*PASSED* — seen at 1440 and 1024 pixels|
|6|A new part sale header|*PASSED* — {{PWXYZ9-248}} shown in full|
|7|Older work orders and part sales keep the number they were given|*PASSED* — part sale {{P2-247}} still reads {{P2-247}}|
|8|Mobile view not broken by the desktop change|*PASSED* — full number at 390 x 844|

h3. The longest Shop ID the app allows

!02-five-character-shop-id.png|width=900,height=304!

_I set the location's Shop ID to {{WXYZ9}}, the five-character maximum, and created a work order. The number came out {{SWXYZ9-17581}} and is shown in full even in a narrow window, with the status pill dropping onto the line underneath instead of squeezing the number._

h3. Part sales

!03-part-sale.png|width=900,height=304!

_Part sales use the same header and behave the same way. An older part sale created before the Shop ID was changed still shows its original number, so nothing existing was renumbered._

h3. What I could not check

* *The absolute worst case of 17 characters was not produced.* That needs a five-character Shop ID together with a ten-digit work order number, and there is no way in the app to set a work order start number. The longest number I could actually put on screen was twelve characters. The unbounded start number is SV-10607 and is out of scope here.
* *There is no production before-picture for the part sale header.* Part sale numbers on production do not use the location's Shop ID — a part sale created in a location with Shop ID 2500 came out as {{P2-73}} — so no production part sale is long enough to be cut off. The branch side is verified; the side-by-side comparison is only available for the work order.
* Shop ID validation itself is not part of this verdict, since it is split out to SV-10607.
